summary: Now sync your data from your data warehouse to Tiktok effortlessly. Read more about Tiktok ad-campaign data here.

content:
In this blog, we will discuss how a user can sync Audience Segments data from your data warehouse to TikTok Ads and run Targeted Ad-Campaigns on TikTok using Reverse ETL.

## Introduction to TikTok Ads

With [billions of monthly active users](https://celebian.com/tiktok-statistics-to-know-in-2024) worldwide and an estimated [$4.6 billion](https://www.businessofapps.com/data/tik-tok-statistics/) in revenue, Tiktok has become the most popular short-form video platform today. With a mission to ‘inspire creativity and bring joy’, the app has successfully carved out a niche among its users, especially GenZ. With such fascinating stats, TikTok automatically becomes the best choice for advertisers too. As per reports, TikTok ads will generate [$11.64 billion](https://www.oberlo.in/statistics/tiktok-ad-revenue) in revenue by the end of 2022. Contrary to general perception, TikTok users actually like ads shown on the platform and they generally have positive reviews regarding the ads such as, ‘fun & engaging’ and ‘trendsetting.’ Furthermore, the platform also supports different ad formats for the advertisers to choose from, as per their target audience and requirements.

## Types of TikTok ads-

In TikTok, advertisers have a variety of ad options to choose from, and each one has its own advantages. The different options are:

-   **In-feed ads:** These ads are probably the most liked ones. The user's "for you" area offers in-feed advertisements that autoplay and let users like, comment, and share content.
-   **Top-view ads:** Users can interact with these Top-view ads just like they can with in-feed ads as they are displayed at the top of the user’s feed.
-   **Brand takeover ads:** The takeover ads, which can take the shape of a video or an image, are only displayed to the user once, and on full-screen.
-   **Branded hashtag challenge:** Tiktok features user-generated content in branded hashtag challenge at 3 different locations. The challenge's own landing page comes last, followed by in-featured banners on the discover page, and in the user’s in-feed.
-   **Branded effects:** The advertisers can apply branded effects on their own or in conjunction with the hashtag challenge. A variety of filters, stickers, and other effects are included. Running targeted ad campaigns on TikTok requires a deep understanding of your audience and the platform's unique content style. TikTok users respond to authenticity and creativity, so your ads need to feel native and engaging while leveraging the platform’s powerful targeting tools. [Collaborating with the right influencers](https://www.heepsy.com/) can amplify your message, ensuring it reaches the right demographic in a way that resonates.
